about_the_game:
The Crimson Contract is a gritty, top-down multiplayer zombie shooter that drops you into a world unraveling at the seams. Quarantine zones have fallen. The infected are spreading. And the government—out of options—has turned to you.

As a contracted mercenary, you’ll enter high-risk containment areas overrun with the undead. Whether alone or with a squad, you’ll fight tooth and nail to reclaim ground and survive long enough to earn your payout. Each mission is a gamble—success earns blood money; failure is permanent.

But something about this outbreak isn’t adding up. The deeper you go, the more you’ll uncover—clues, cover-ups, and a disturbing truth buried beneath the government's cry for help.

Key Features

🧟 Brutal, Top-Down Action
Engage in fast-paced, tactical combat against growing hordes with distinct behaviors.

🤝 Multiplayer Co-op and Solo PvE Modes
Team up with friends or go solo across multiple mission types—from extraction runs to stronghold defenses.

🧰 Customization & Progression
Upgrade your gear, unlock powerful weapons, and tailor your merc to match your playstyle.

💀 Consumables, Contracts & Risk-Reward Systems
Choose your loadout wisely and make every bullet count. The higher the risk, the greater the rewards—and the consequences.

🎮 Optimized for Multiplayer & Controller Support
Built for both keyboard/mouse and gamepad users, with smooth multiplayer integration for seamless squad play.

You’re not here to be a hero. You’re here to survive—and get paid.

Welcome to The Crimson Contract.

content_descriptors.notes: Players engage in weapons-based combat with Zombies including guns and explosives. Zombies seek and attack player characters.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or later / SteamOS 3.0 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400S @ 2.5 GHz or AMD FX-4320 @ 4 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon R9 270X (2GB VRAM) with Vulkan support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS X 10.15, or later
  • Processor: Apple M1, M2, or Intel x86 - 64bit OS required
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics Card
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: A descent into zombie-infested zones, where every bullet fired paints the landscape in crimson and every survivor earns their rewards in blood & sweat. Unravel the secrets behind the viral outbreak as you navigate dangerous quarantine zones and discover the true meaning of the blood-soaked contract.
